scoped_mathematical_obligations: The local class uses the same varying Hermitian omega and Garding cone as the book; no comparison with a flat-metric cone is assumed.
Compact containment lets one fixed rho=C|z|^2 satisfy ddc rho>=2omega.
Upper tests transform by q-rho, and adding ddc rho-omega preserves the closed cone.
Smooth addition preserves canonical representatives, decreasing approximation and local boundedness.
The correction is only a one-way inclusion; tau is closed but tau-omega is nonclosed.
Local ordered construction, uniform smooth approximation, coefficient/CLN bounds and positive traces remain declared inputs.
The degree r=m-1 capacity is defined from positive competitor measures; its monotonicity and countable subadditivity follow directly.
Its outer-open version agrees on opens, is countably subadditive, and is finite on compact sets by CLN and compact neighborhoods.
The smooth absolute-form estimate is used only for q<m, including its q=0 convention.
A fixed uniform translation and scaling puts sum(f_i)+rho between -1 and0 without changing cone membership.
The binomial trace expansion uses only smooth potentials; every term is nonnegative by polarized cone positivity.
Replacing tau by omega in a mixed trace costs a nonnegative term since tau-omega>=0; the factorial/binomial coefficient is retained.
Rough coefficient domination is obtained by lower semicontinuity of total variation on opens and then outer capacity, not a simultaneous diagonal limit.
The common exceptional set covers all countably many weights using summable capacities.
Dini is applied to compact K minus G, not to the generally noncompact domain minus G.
Bounded Tietze extension pairs with the whole weakly converging signed measure; no convergence with a discontinuous closed-set indicator is claimed.
The weighted pairing error is controlled by the uniform coefficient mass and the small exceptional capacity, with j tending to infinity before epsilon.
Conditional induction obtains degree p by ddc of a converging bounded weighted degree p-1 current.
Measure-coefficient convergence is asserted only below degree m; uniform coefficient bounds extend smooth-test convergence to continuous tests.
Symmetry follows from simultaneous smooth approximations only after the conditional induction, avoiding an early exchange of limits.
The raw subset expansion uses closed tau=ddc rho and closed recursive currents; all signs and subset orders are explicit.
The global transfer requires the hypotheses on a finite coordinate cover, not solely on one ball.
Fixed nonclosed omega powers preserve distributional limits without being differentiated or replaced by closed forms.
The top Qm Radon convergence uses its proved positivity and mass bound; unwedged Dm order zero and top weighted convergence are not inferred.
Exact Stokes has k d omega omega^(k-1), including k=n-m+1; k=0 removes the drift term.
Quasicontinuity, local approximation/localization and weighted-energy dependency closure have not been certified by this selected read.
